title: Holiday Gift Guide 2026
summary: Find the best gifts for gamers this holiday season, no matter your budget. The Turtle Beach Gift Finder offers even more personalized recommendations.
body_markdown:
It’s November, so you know what that means: it’s time to start thinking about holiday gifts for your favorite gamer. That might be a child or relative. It might be your best gaming buddy or a significant other (maybe they’re the same person?). You could even be your own favorite gamer! Treat yourself! I won’t judge.


Whoever you’re buying gifts for, Turtle Beach has a ton of options at the perfect intersection of form and function – stuff they’ll want to use every time they sit down to game. Why? Well Turtle Beach is only TechRadar's[Gaming Brand of the Year](https://www.techradar.com/tech/techradar-readers-choice-awards-2026-winners) with multiple products winning in key categories. So every time your favorite gamer picks up the awesome gift you got them, they’ll remember just how much you love them and, more importantly, how good you are at giving gifts.


So, if you want to win at gift-giving this year, check out this guide to find the perfect thing for the perfect person in your life.


**Bliss on a Budget Tier**


You might be surprised to find that gaming gifts from a name-brand source can be actually affordable while offering amazing quality. You may not get all of the expansive features of mid- and premium-tier items, but there’s some serious bang-for-buck to be found under $100.


***Atlas 200 Wired Headset*** ****** The Atlas 200 at $59.99 is an amazing wired headset option that works on just about any platform. Your favorite gamer will be getting immersive, precision-tuned sound with 50mm Nanoclear™ Drivers and come in loud and clear over voice chat with a uni-directional, flip-to-mute microphone. Plus, with a floating headband and patented ProSpecs dual-foam ear cushions, even gamers with glasses will feel comfortable wearing the Atlas all day long.


Stealth™ 500 Wireless Headset ******


****** Coming in at $89.99, the Stealth™ 500 introduces wireless connectivity via USB transmitter or Bluetooth® — your choice! With the QuickSwitch button, the headset can even swap between the two at the press of a button. Connecting to multiple devices has never been so easy! The Stealth™ 500 also works with the Swarm™ II app, allowing your favorite gamer to customize their audio however they please, with options including a 10-band audio EQ, audio & microphone presets, and more


******


***Stealth™ 600 Wireless Headset***


****** The real under $100 budget hack, though, is finding Stealth™ 600 **** on sale. Going from the 500 to the 600, you may be asking, “what do those extra 100 numbers get me?”


Well, the 600 takes all of the best aspects of the 500 and adds an 80-hour battery with a quick charge feature. It also introduces features like A.I. noise reduction for voice chat clarity and a remappable wheel & mode button for changing audio settings on the fly. Regularly $109.99, this headset is an absolute budget powerhouse, ever better if you find it on sale.


***Afterglow™ Wave Controller***


****** At Turtle Beach, you’re spoiled for choice when it comes to fashionable, affordable controllers with next-level features like Hall-Effect technology, customizable RGB lighting, and unique designs. Coming in at $49.99, The Afterglow™ Wave XBOX controller is the epitome of all of those qualities. Plus, with five unique colorways that complement the controller’s unique RGB wave design, you can easily find an option that your favorite gamer will love.


**Set Them Up Tier**


When it comes to giving gifts, you’re not satisfied with just getting the job done — you want to go the extra mile, give them those “wow-worthy” features, and really impress. These mid-range options will set your favorite gamer up with their next go-to device for many, many play sessions to come.


***Stealth™ 700 Headset***


******


Take the Stealth 600 and add huge, 60mm Eclipse™ dual drivers for


unparalleled audio quality, and you’ve got a pretty serious headset already. Couple that with


the CrossPlay wireless system, offering dual USB transmitters and simultaneous Bluetooth® connectivity for quick and easy connection to gaming consoles, and you have a serious entry for best present under the tree.


******


***Stealth™ Pivot Wireless Smart Controller***


****** The Stealth™ Pivot controller is just cool. No other controller lets you flip the buttons and analog sticks into the controller to reveal a whole new set of buttons. This is perfect gift for a gamer who plays a wide range of genres and wants a controller that can instantly adapt to whatever they want to play, especially if those genres include fighting or retro games. This is unique gadget is a one-of-a-kind jewel that belongs in any serious gamer’s collection.


**Spoil Them Tier**


Are you getting a gift for someone you love and care deeply about? Maybe they had a hard year or put in a lot of extra work worthy of a proper celebration. Perhaps you’re looking to impress your partner — or someone you wish was your partner. Rest assured, if they’re a gamer, you will instantly win major points with them if they unbox anything in this premium category this holiday season. The unmatched quality and long-lasting peak performance of these no-compromise options will put a smile on their face every time they use your gift. Consider yourself having gone above and beyond.


Stealth™ Pro II Wireless Headset


This is the cream of the crop when it comes to gaming audio. We’re talking the winner of TechRadar's 2026 Readers' Choice Award for Gaming Device of the Year. Plus, the Stealth™ Pro II is officially certified by the Japan Audio Society, which if you don’t know is THE name in determining what is or isn’t Hi-Res Audio. The Pro II earns that distinction by being able to pump out24-bit/96kHz wireless sound via an ultra-low latency 2.4GHz USB connection on compatible devices. The 60mm Eclipse™ dual drivers and adjustable Active Noise Cancellation also work together to deliver an immersive, high-fidelity sound with exceptional clarity and detail.


Pair that audio excellence with the exclusive CrossPlay 2.0 feature (an industry-first system for wirelessly switching between up to four audio sources) dual swappable 40-hour batteries for endless power, an exceptional broadcast-quality floating mic, built-in beamforming microphones — the list of features goes on. However, all of those amazing features make your holiday shopping list very simple: get them the Stealth™ Pro II and you won’t regret it.


***Stealth™ Ultra II Controller***


The Stealth™ Ultra II is the controller that brings everything to the table. The tactile microswitch buttons and AntiDrift™ TMR thumbsticks — the best in the game. Customization ­­— unmatched with the Connected Command Touch Screen and Swarm II™ app. That’s not even to mention the four mappable quick action buttons, adjustable trigger stops, and lag-free wireless technology. It even includes a rapid charge dock and hard-shell case with a charge-through opening. It’s the complete package, everything the most important gamer in your life could possibly ask for.


**Superfan Gamers**


These gamers know what they love, and they love to show it off. If your favorite gamer wants rep their favorite game or complement their well-crafted vibe with themed devices, they can do so without sacrificing the peak quality they deserve.


**The GTA Gamer:**


**Pacific Skyline Bundle**


With pastel palm tree artwork inspired by the west coast, the Pacific Skyline design fits perfectly with the aesthetic of GTA 6's fictionalcoastal setting of Leonida. Combine that with competitive specs and features to back up the good looks, and you'll see why TechRadar readers awarded the Pacific Skyline wireless controller as 2026's best gaming controller. When you add the Pacific SkylineRecon 70


multiplatform wired headset to that package, you have an instant setup-maker for the GTA fan in your life.


**The Minecraft Gamer:**


**Rematch™ Wireless RGB Gaming Controller – Minecraft™**


****


This officially licensed controller is a treat for Minecraft **™** gamers. Not only does it offer top-of-the-line TMR thumbsticks and Hall-Effect hair triggers, it also features an iconic Minecraft™ design and customizable RGB lighting that even non-Minecraft **™** fans can appreciate.


**The Fortnite Gamer:**


**Victrix™ Pro BFG™ Reloaded Wireless Modular Controller – Fortnite™ Drift**


The Victrix™ Pro BFG™ Reloaded **** controller is no ordinary controller — it’s a premium wireless option that offers swappable, high-quality modular components for endless customizability and longevity. The BFG™ Reloaded is already an amazing choice for Fortnite™ gamers based on performance alone, but the unique Drift design and in-game bonus included with the controller (Jellie Outfit for XBOX, Guff Outfit for PS


®


5


, and Nite Owl Pickaxe


for PC) really takes this over the top as an epic holiday gift option.


That rounds out this year’s holiday gift guide, but don’t forget to check out our[interactive gift finder](https://www.turtlebeach.com/?giftfinder=true) if you need more personalized recommendations. Happy holidays!
